text.en: Bholu, Jagat, Rani and Mini play hide and seek. Mini looks from the top and sees who is hiding.

The children play hide and seek in four scenes. Jagat says, All of you go and hide, I will find you.
What you see depends on where you stand. From the top, Mini can see all the children. If Rani faces the hut, she may not see who is hiding near it.
Bholu is amazed to see how a tree looks from the top, while Jagat clicks a picture of the tree from the front.
Three children draw the same brick, but their pictures look different because they look from different places.
These are the top view, front view and side view.
Name objects and say which view is drawn.
